question: What does the idiom 'Clutching at straws' mean?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Hoping without reason**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Clutching at straws"** means making a desperate attempt to find some hope or solution, even when the chances are very slim. (बिना किसी तर्कसंगत कारण के आशा करना) • **Example:** Realizing that the situation was out of control, he started clutching at straws, hoping for a miracle. • **"Hoping without reason"** refers to having hope or belief in an outcome, even when there is no logical or practical basis for it. (बिना किसी ठोस कारण के उम्मीद करना) • **Example:** Despite the unfavorable odds, she kept hoping without reason that things would improve. • Hence, the idiom "Clutching at straws" directly aligns with the meaning of "Hoping without reason." Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Hoping without reason**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Laughing loudly** (जोर से हंसना): Refers to laughing in an uncontrollable or very loud manner. • **Example:** The audience was laughing loudly at the comedian’s jokes. • **Boasting unnecessarily** (अनावश्यक रूप से डींग मारना): Refers to talking with excessive pride about oneself or something, even when it is not required. • **Example:** He kept boasting unnecessarily about his achievements in front of everyone. • **Winning easily** (आसानी से जीतना): Refers to achieving victory with little or no effort. • **Example:** The team won the match easily due to their excellent strategy. 52:Tc54, The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Stay neutral.
